summary: End-to-end testing of Dobryi Energy site (French corporate marketing site). All backend endpoints pass (7/7 pytest). All key frontend flows work: home hero/CTAs/solutions/markets/trust-bar, navigation to all pages, Solutions 5 sections, Realisations gallery with 6 items + working filters, About page, Contact form success flow, floating WhatsApp/phone actions, footer email/phone. Only minor data-testid naming deviations from spec (see below); no blocking issues.

issues: When hero image is bright behind, the top-nav links (01 Solutions / 02 Réalisations / 03 À propos / 04 Contact) appear low-contrast against the light background at the very top of the home page. A subtle backdrop/blur or scroll-elevated background would improve legibility.

action_items: OPTIONAL/testability: About.jsx uses data-testid="valeurs" and data-testid="habilitations" (without the `about-` prefix used elsewhere), and the Chiffres section has no data-testid at all. The review spec expected `about-valeurs`, `about-chiffres`, `about-habilitations`. Consider renaming to `about-valeurs`, `about-habilitations`, and adding `data-testid="about-chiffres"` on the chiffres <section> for consistent test hooks. Not a functional blocker.
OPTIONAL/design: Improve header contrast when overlaying bright hero backgrounds.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is well-structured (<250 lines), uses async/await for Mongo, excludes ObjectId via UUID id field, uses Pydantic + EmailStr validation, and returns proper 422 on invalid input. Good.
Emergent email integration correctly guarded by EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY presence, logs but does not crash on external failure. Good.
Frontend: React Router routes match /solutions, /realisations, /a-propos, /contact — all match nav data-testids. Good use of data-testid across interactive elements.
Minor: Console warning 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position...' emitted on home (likely from Lenis/framer-motion scroll-linked component). Cosmetic; no runtime impact observed.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ devis records were created in Mongo `devis` collection during backend tests (respecting the 2-email cap). These are UUID-tagged (TEST_User_<hex>) and safe to prune.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers /api/health, /api/realisations (6 curated items), and /api/devis (valid + 3 invalid cases + persistence). Devis endpoint triggers a real Resend email via Emergent proxy — the test suite intentionally sends exactly 2 valid POSTs to respect the 2-email cap for dobryienergy@gmail.com. If re-running, be aware more emails will be sent. Frontend: all data-testids verified except About page uses `valeurs`/`habilitations` (no `about-` prefix) and lacks `about-chiffres`. Contact form success flow validated via mocked route to avoid extra emails.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no critical bugs observed. All 7 backend tests pass in 1.67s; all frontend flows in the review request behave correctly (home hero + CTAs, 5 solution cards, navigation, Solutions 5 detail sections, Realisations 6 cards + working filter (6→2 for Agricole), Contact form success, floating WhatsApp/phone with correct hrefs, footer email/phone).
